summary: Iteration 11 testing completed - Inventory ↔ Issues cross-linking features fully verified. All backend and frontend features working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: PUT /api/items/{id} with condition='Needs Repair' auto-creates an issue
Backend: PUT /api/items/{id} with condition='Needs Repair' sets item status to 'Under Maintenance'
Backend: Auto-created issue has correct issue_type='Malfunction' and severity='Medium'
Backend: Auto-created issue has reported_by and reported_by_email from current user
Backend: PUT /api/items/{id} with condition='Damaged' auto-creates issue with type='Damage' and severity='High'
Backend: POST /api/issues creates issue with all new fields (issue_type, reported_by, reported_by_email, assigned_to, assigned_to_email, vendor_contact)
Backend: POST /api/issues also sets item condition to 'Needs Repair' if it was OK
Backend: PATCH /api/issues/{id} with status='Resolved' sets item condition to 'OK' and status to 'Available'
Backend: PATCH /api/issues/{id} accepts body with IssueUpdate fields (description, severity, assigned_to, resolution_notes etc)
Frontend: Issues page has search input that filters issues
Frontend: Issues page has status filter dropdown (Open/Resolved/All)
Frontend: Issues page shows expandable rows with reporter info, assigned to, emails, vendor contact
Frontend: Report Issue dialog has all fields: item, description, issue_type, severity, reported_by, reporter_email, assigned_to, assignee_email, vendor_contact
Frontend: Edit Issue dialog allows updating: description, type, severity, status, assigned_to, assignee_email, vendor_contact, resolution_notes
Frontend: Resolve button on issue updates status and restores item
Frontend: Inventory Edit dialog has Condition dropdown with options: OK, Needs Repair, Damaged
Frontend: Inventory Edit dialog has Status dropdown with options: Available, Under Maintenance, Reserved, Lost
seed_data_creation: Test items and issues created during testing were cleaned up at end of test run
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 11 verified Inventory ↔ Issues cross-linking: 1) Setting item condition to 'Needs Repair' or 'Damaged' auto-creates an issue and sets status to 'Under Maintenance', 2) Resolving an issue restores item condition to 'OK' and status to 'Available', 3) Manual issue creation sets item condition to 'Needs Repair', 4) Issues page has expandable rows with full detail (reporter, assignee, emails, vendor contact), 5) Edit Issue dialog supports all new fields. Dark theme styling is correct.
